item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Sat 14:00): The Happy Pod: The 'amazing’ device that controls Tourette's
item.description:
Originally published Sat 21 Nov 2026 14:00 IST.

We meet 17-year-old Mylo who's taken part in a trial of the watch-like device that suppresses his Tourette's tics. He can even now go to the cinema without fear of causing a disturbance by constantly moving or clearing his throat. Also: the chef in Japan who's known poverty and illness and now offers free meals to people in the position he was once in; the NASA spacecraft, Voyager One, that's become the first human-made object to reach a point one light day from Earth; the surf school in Senegal that's trying to turn its pupils into world champions; and the children with autism and ADHD who've been helped by alpacas.

Image: 17-year-old Mylo wearing the device. Credit: BBC News.

Our weekly collection of inspiring, uplifting and happy news from around the world.

Presenter: Holly Gibbs. Music composed by Iona Hampson
